test.create_query: CREATE TABLE agg_in_order_lc_16 (a LowCardinality(String), b LowCardinality(String), v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY a
CREATE TABLE agg_in_order_lc_1024 (a LowCardinality(String), b LowCardinality(String), v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY a
CREATE TABLE agg_in_order_lc_65536 (a LowCardinality(String), b LowCardinality(String), v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY a
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO agg_in_order_lc_16 SELECT concat('a', leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 16)), 8, '0')), concat('b', toString(intHash32(number) % 14)), number FROM numbers_mt(655200)
INSERT INTO agg_in_order_lc_1024 SELECT concat('a', leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 1024)), 8, '0')), concat('b', toString(intHash32(number) % 14)), number FROM numbers_mt(10483200)
INSERT INTO agg_in_order_lc_65536 SELECT concat('a', leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 65536)), 8, '0')), concat('b', toString(intHash32(number) % 14)), number FROM numbers_mt(10485760)
test.query: SELECT a, b, sum(v) FROM agg_in_order_lc_16 GROUP BY a, b SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, sum(v) FROM agg_in_order_lc_1024 GROUP BY a, b SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, sum(v) FROM agg_in_order_lc_65536 GROUP BY a, b SETTINGS optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1 FORMAT Null
